hook.name: BoltFeeHookV3
hook.description: A launch-protection hook that applies a 10% buy/sell tax on swaps of ≥1.5% of supply during the first 6 blocks after pool initialization, diverting taxed tokens or ETH to a treasury. After the window, it permanently triggers internal self-swaps to convert accumulated tokens (≥5M threshold) into ETH forwarded to the treasury on every subsequent user swap.
